reason: Integrates CCSWITCH with DSH by listing and importing model providers, while also providing a vision-model image description tool and GUI import interface.

summaries.zh: 从本地 CCSWITCH 数据库列出并批量导入模型供应商到 DSH，并提供调用视觉模型描述图片的工具。
summaries.en: Lists and batch-imports model providers from a local CCSWITCH database into DSH, with an additional tool for describing images through a vision model.

capabilities: Reads a local CCSWITCH SQLite database through a subprocess
Imports selected model provider settings into DSH
Writes provider credentials to DSH credentials storage
Sends images to a configured vision model for description
